rationale: Public GET is cacheable, but json sets Vary: Origin only when allowed Origin is present. A no-Origin cache entry may be reused for browser Origin requests without Access-Control-Allow-Origin. This can prevent the main public-BEST feature from working depending on cache sequence.

actual_next_action.description: Inspect response construction for public GET; ensure Vary: Origin for every origin-dependent cacheable variant and test no-Origin/allowed-Origin/denied-Origin variants in sequence.

bounds: Independent source/spec inspection only; no live cache reproduction, production-player data, human feel assessment, or Jev answer inspection.
